positions: ICRS from SIMBAD (Harvard mirror), propagated with astropy apply_space_motion; ALWAYS propagate to each exposure MJD
n_exp_d456: exposures in D4-D6 from data/raw/spherex_exposures_d456.parquet (QR2 to MJD 61241 + QR3 partial); D1-D3 share the same sky footprints (dichroic), so total per target ~2x

targets.name: Barnard's Star
targets.why: Highest proper motion star (10.4 arcsec/yr = 1.7 SPHEREx px/yr): visible motion between survey passes

targets.name: Epsilon Indi B (Ba+Bb)
targets.otype: BD* (T1+T6 binary, ~0.7 arcsec separation: unresolved by SPHEREx)
targets.why: Brown dwarf pair, 4.7 arcsec/yr; methane absorption ~3.3 um and CO 4.6 um in spectrum; star eps Ind A ~6.7 arcmin away (bright, ghost/saturation risk)

targets.name: WISE 0855-0714
targets.why: Coldest known brown dwarf; very faint below 4 um, detectable only at ~4.5-5 um (D6); moves 8.2 arcsec/yr

targets.name: RW Aurigae
targets.otype: TT* (classical T Tauri, binary A+B 1.4 arcsec)
targets.why: Irregular variable with deep dimming episodes; IR excess from disk; light curve across epochs

targets.name: R Draconis
targets.why: Mira variable near the North Ecliptic Pole deep field: >1200 exposures, best-sampled light curve; very bright -> saturation/OVERFLOW flags in short-lambda bands
